newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ford's Japan sales unit to change name.
newsitem.headline: Ford's Japan sales unit to change name.

text.p: Autorama Inc, the Japanese sales venture between Ford Motor Co and Mazda Motor Corp, said on Tuesday it will change its name to Ford Sales Japan Ltd, effective January 8, 1997.
Autorama was formed in 1981 as the Japanese dealer for Mazda-made Ford brand cars and cars imported from Ford's units outside Japan.

Autorama is now owned 45.1 pct each by Mazda and Ford Japan, while the remaining 9.8 pct is held by nine Japanese investors, including damage insurers. No change in ownership in Autorama was planned, the company said.

Konen Suzuki, chairman of Autorama and the president of Ford Motor Co (Japan) Ltd (Ford Japan), Ford's Japanese unit that imports Ford cars, will become the new president of Ford Sales Japan on January 8, succeeding Yoshiaki Yamanaka, Autorama's current president. Yamanaka will return to Mazda.
The chairman's post at Ford Sales Japan will be vacant when Suzuki becomes president.
Autorama also said that Ford Japan's product planning and marketing operations will be merged into Ford Sales Japan.
